Explicit analytic prerequisite restatement:
E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure and canonical volume, including dimension zero. mu is any finite measure; no absolute-continuity or Gibbs hypothesis on mu is required.
D is the same closable real-linear partial operator, with original graph iff actual C-infinity compact scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, both classes identified mu-a.e. This semantics comes from the existing gradient producer in the paper consumer.
The tested scalar f is only C1 and compactly supported. Its gradient, L2 integrability and actual closure membership are conclusions, not inputs.
For every finite Borel measure mu, every closable partial gradient D whose original graph is exactly compact smooth scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, and every C1 compact scalar f, derive MemLp f 2 mu and MemLp (gradient f) 2 mu and prove the actual pair of their L2 classes lies in D.closure.graph. No graph-membership or approximation certificate is supplied.
Same actual compact-gradient graph closure admits C1 compact function/gradient pairs; actual positive-epsilon weak resolvent has all C1 compact weighted volume tests and genuine ordinary weak gradient. Actual PBPS reflected conditional R/S law and original fixed D precede epsilon/input. No local H2, global operator-core/Bochner, conditional Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1, PBPS hypocoercivity or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

decoder_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space and canonical Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. All section ambient instances remain part of the contract. NNReal denotes nonnegative real scalars.

Lp F 2 mu is the actual L2 quotient space; MemLp means a measurable representative with finite L2 norm. MemLp.toLp embeds the actual function class and agrees mu-a.e. Inner products of L2 classes integrate pointwise real inner products against mu.

ContDiff R 1 means C1; infinity means smooth. gradient f is the Riesz representative of the actual Frechet derivative fderiv R f. HasCompactSupport means the topological closure of nonzero support is compact.

LinearPMap is a real-linear partial operator on its stated submodule domain. Its graph consists of pairs of a domain element and its actual output. D.IsClosable means its topological graph closure is single-valued; D.closure is that same closed operator. Coercions from its domain and from L2 classes choose the usual representatives. No test membership is built into these definitions.

Measure.tilted f is exp(f)/integral exp(f) times the original measure. Probability/nonzero normalization is not built into this definition. Kernel is a measurable probability-transition family when IsMarkovKernel holds. A conditional kernel disintegrates the specified joint measure; measure.map is actual pushforward and prod is the actual independent product. stdGaussian denotes the standard real Hilbert Gaussian. All volume or law integrals specify their actual measure.

/-!
# Compact C1 functions belong to the same closed gradient graph

Analytic prerequisite for PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Appendix C.1 and the
SPHMC2609.06906v1 Section4.1 BL route. Actual normalized compact mollifiers
jointly approximate a function and its genuine gradient. A finite measure
allows bounded dominated convergence; no uniform support/domain certificate
is assumed. The original exact compact smooth graph is retained.

Finite-dimensional real Borel Hilbert spaces include dimension zero.
This is not local H2, a generator core, global Bochner, Poincare or BL.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.CompactC1GradientDomain
open MeasureTheory ContinuousLinearMap Filter InnerProductSpace ProbabilityTheory
open scoped Convolution Topology ContDiff RealInnerProductSpace NNReal
noncomputable section
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

private theorem mollifier_fderiv {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport f) (φ : ContDiffBump (0:E)) :
    let g := (φ.normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] f)
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧
      fderiv ℝ g = φ.normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] (fderiv ℝ f) := by
  let g := (φ.normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] f)
  refine ⟨φ.hasCompactSupport_normed.contDiff_convolution_left (lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      φ.contDiff_normed hf.continuous.locallyIntegrable,
    φ.hasCompactSupport_normed.convolution (lsmul ℝ ℝ) hc,?_⟩
  funext x
  have hd := hc.hasFDerivAt_convolution_right (μ := (volume : Measure E)) (lsmul ℝ ℝ)
    (φ.integrable_normed (μ := (volume : Measure E))).locallyIntegrable hf x
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  congr 1


private theorem mollifier_squared_error {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {h : E → F} (hh : Continuous h) {C : ℝ} (hC : ∀ x, ‖h x‖≤C)
    (φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0:E))
    (hφ : Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖((φ n).normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] h) x-h x‖^2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let g := fun n => (φ n).normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] h
  have hc : 0≤C := (norm_nonneg (h (0:E))).trans (hC _)
  have hg (n : ℕ) : Continuous (g n) :=
    (φ n).hasCompactSupport_normed.continuous_convolution_left (lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (φ n).continuous_normed hh.locallyIntegrable
  have hb (n : ℕ) (x : E) : ‖g n x‖≤C := by
    have ht := dist_convolution_le (μ := (volume : Measure E)) (x₀ := x) (z₀ := (0:F)) hc
      (φ n).support_normed_eq.subset (φ n).nonneg_normed (φ n).integral_normed
      hh.aestronglyMeasurable (fun t _ => by simpa only [dist_zero_right] using hC t)
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using ht
  have he := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := μ)
    (F := fun n x => ‖g n x-h x‖^2) (f := fun _ => (0:ℝ))
    (fun _ => (2*C)^2)
    (fun n => ((hg n).sub hh).norm.pow 2 |>.aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const _) (fun n => by
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).2
      exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hb n x,hC x])) (by
      filter_upwards with x
      have ht := ContDiffBump.convolution_tendsto_right_of_continuous
        (μ := (volume : Measure E)) hφ hh x
      simpa only [g,sub_self,norm_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)] using
        ((ht.sub (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => h x) atTop (𝓝 (h x)))).norm.pow 2))
  simpa only [integral_zero] using he


private theorem compact_c1_approximation (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hc : HasCompactSupport f)
    (φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0:E))
    (hφ : Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    let g := fun n => (φ n).normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] f
    (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (g n) ∧ HasCompactSupport (g n)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g n x-f x‖^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (g n) x-fderiv ℝ f x‖^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  let g := fun n => (φ n).normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] f
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hf.continuous.norm.bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport hc.norm
  have hCb (x : E) : ‖f x‖≤C := hC ⟨x,rfl⟩
  have hd := hf.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := hd.norm.bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport (hc.fderiv ℝ).norm
  have hBb (x : E) : ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖≤B := hB ⟨x,rfl⟩
  have hgi (n : ℕ) := mollifier_fderiv hf hc (φ n)
  refine ⟨fun n => ⟨(hgi n).1,(hgi n).2.1⟩,
    mollifier_squared_error μ hf.continuous hCb φ hφ,?_⟩
  have he := mollifier_squared_error μ hd hBb φ hφ
  convert he using 1
  funext n
  dsimp only [g]
  rw [(hgi n).2.2]


private theorem l2_convergence {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (μ : Measure E)
    (g : ℕ → E → F) (f : E → F) (hg : ∀ n, MemLp (g n) 2 μ) (hf : MemLp f 2 μ)
    (he : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖g n x-f x‖^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (hg n).toLp (g n)) atTop (𝓝 (hf.toLp f)) := by
  have hn (n : ℕ) : ‖(hg n).toLp (g n)-hf.toLp f‖ =
      Real.sqrt (∫ x, ‖g n x-f x‖^2 ∂μ) := by
    rw [norm_eq_sqrt_re_inner (𝕜 := ℝ), L2.inner_def]
    congr 1
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub ((hg n).toLp (g n)) (hf.toLp f),
      (hg n).coeFn_toLp, hf.coeFn_toLp] with x hs hx hy
    simp only [hs,Pi.sub_apply,hx,hy,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
  simp_rw [dist_eq_norm,hn]
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_zero] using he.sqrt


theorem compact_c1_in_closed_gradient (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ) (hD : D.IsClosable)
    (hgraph : ∀ (a : Lp ℝ 2 μ) (H : Lp E 2 μ), (a,H) ∈ D.graph ↔
      ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
        a =ᵐ[μ] φ ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] gradient φ)
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hc : HasCompactSupport f) :
    ∃ hp : MemLp f 2 μ, ∃ hq : MemLp (gradient f) 2 μ,
      (hp.toLp f,hq.toLp (gradient f)) ∈ D.closure.graph := by
  let φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0:E) := fun n =>
    { rIn := ((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹, rOut := 2*((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹,
      rIn_pos := by positivity,
      rIn_lt_rOut := by
        have h : 0<((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹ := by positivity
        linarith }
  have hφ : Tendsto (fun n => (φ n).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n:ℝ)+1)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp
        (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right atTop (1:ℝ) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
    simpa only [mul_zero] using ht.const_mul 2
  let g := fun n => (φ n).normed volume ⋆[lsmul ℝ ℝ, volume] f
  obtain ⟨hgi,hgf,hgd⟩ := compact_c1_approximation μ hf hc φ hφ
  have gradCont (a : E → ℝ) (ha : ContDiff ℝ 1 a) : Continuous (gradient a) :=
    (toDual ℝ E).symm.continuous.comp (ha.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero)
  have gradComp (a : E → ℝ) (ha : HasCompactSupport a) : HasCompactSupport (gradient a) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact ha.isCompact ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx (by simp [gradient,fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hn])
  have hp := hf.continuous.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := μ) hc (p := 2)
  have hq := (gradCont f hf).memLp_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := μ) (gradComp f hc) (p := 2)
  have hgp (n) := (hgi n).1.continuous.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := μ) (hgi n).2 (p := 2)
  have hgq (n) := (gradCont (g n) (contDiff_infty.mp (hgi n).1 1)).memLp_of_hasCompactSupport
    (μ := μ) (gradComp (g n) (hgi n).2) (p := 2)
  have htq : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, ‖gradient (g n) x-gradient f x‖^2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    convert hgd using 1
    funext n
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [gradient,← map_sub,(toDual ℝ E).symm.norm_map]
    rfl
  have htp := l2_convergence μ g f hgp hp hgf
  have htq' := l2_convergence μ (fun n => gradient (g n)) (gradient f) hgq hq htq
  refine ⟨hp,hq,?_⟩
  rw [← hD.graph_closure_eq_closure_graph]
  apply D.graph.isClosed_topologicalClosure.mem_of_tendsto (htp.prodMk_nhds htq')
  filter_upwards [] with n
  apply D.graph.le_topologicalClosure
  exact (hgraph _ _).mpr ⟨g n,(hgi n).1,(hgi n).2,(hgp n).coeFn_toLp,(hgq n).coeFn_toLp⟩


end
end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.CompactC1GradientDomain

steps.title: Construct genuine normalized compact mollifiers
steps.text: Choose bump radii (n+1)^-1 and twice that value. Normalize the actual smooth compact nonnegative kernel against canonical volume; it has integral one and shrinking support. The approximation is the real convolution g_n=rho_n*f, not a supplied approximating sequence.

steps.title: Differentiate the actual convolution
steps.text: Compact support and C1 regularity justify the right-variable derivative theorem. Actual g_n is compact smooth and its Frechet derivative is convolution with Df. This establishes a joint function/derivative sequence.

steps.title: Derive both squared L2 limits from bounded domination
steps.text: Compact continuous f and its continuous compact derivative have bounded norms C and B. Kernel positivity/mass one bounds each convolution by the same constant. Pointwise mollifier convergence plus the integrable constant (2C)^2 or (2B)^2 under finite mu gives both genuine squared-error integral limits. No uniform-convergence or common-support premise is needed in this finite-measure argument.

steps.title: Convert derivative and integral convergence into true L2 topology
steps.text: The Riesz isometry identifies gradient with the actual Frechet derivative and preserves norms of differences. The L2 inner-product norm formula identifies norm difference with square root of the actual squared-error integral. Both genuine L2 classes converge jointly.

steps.title: Use the original graph and its actual closure
steps.text: Each pair belongs to the original exact compact smooth gradient graph by its representatives. Its joint L2 limit lies in the closed topological graph closure. Actual closability identifies that closure with D.closure.graph; the same operator is preserved.

steps.title: Keep the analytic boundary explicit
steps.text: This derives C1 compact domain membership only. Noncompact constants/linear observables still need true tail cutoffs; local H2 and the generator core/global Bochner are separate. Zero dimension is included without a unit-vector assumption.

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure,including dimension zero. Let mu be any finite measure on E. Write X=L2(mu;R) and Y=L2(mu;E) for the actual quotient spaces. Let D:X partial-linear[R]->Y be a real linear partial operator on a submodule domain,and assume D is closable. Assume its graph is exactly the smooth compactly supported gradient graph:for every a in X and H in Y,
  (a,H) in graph(D) if and only if there exists phi:E->R such that
    phi is globally smooth,
    phi has compact support,
    the representative of a equals phi mu-almost everywhere,
    the representative of H equals grad phi mu-almost everywhere.
The gradient is the actual Riesz representative of the Frechet derivative. For every real-valued f:E->R that is globally C1 and has compact support,there exist proofs hp of MemLp(f,2,mu) and hq of MemLp(grad f,2,mu) such that
  (hp.toLp(f),hq.toLp(grad f)) in graph(closure(D)).
MemLp asserts suitable measurability and finite L2 norm of the actual functions;toLp is their actual quotient embedding,agreeing almost everywhere with its input. Closability means the topological closure of graph(D) is single-valued,and closure(D) is that closed partial operator. Thus the graph membership relates the L2 class of the actual C1 function to the L2 class of its actual gradient. No membership is built into the operator definition.
The theorem supplies both function/gradient L2 membership and closure-graph membership. It does not construct D,assume the finite measure is a probability or absolutely continuous measure,assume D has dense domain,upgrade f to smoothness,choose a different output gradient,or assert a pointwise identity of all possible representatives.
